comments.author: lurklord_
comments.body: Any plans for the ability to generate locally?

comments.author: RandomFlareA
comments.body: You should show the actual generation and editing process, because it takes a lot of tries and manual editing. Not nearly as easy as you show in your ads. Super misleading. :/

comments.author: ZHName
comments.body: The tool is comprehensive right now in Aseprite but the tutorials and ease of use is lacking quite a bit. I've been using it a while now but it is the lack of video step by step tutorials that keep me from making full use of its many features.

replies.author: Kaninen_Ka9en
replies.body: You feel the same way about the latest tutorials as well?

replies.author: ZHName
replies.body:
Yeah I think others are struggling as well as I saw similar comments on some of the tutorials on YT.  

Update: I don't usually like web apps but your company is doing tremendously at innovating here in this pixel games space. Fantastic work! MCP, easier and easier ways to integrate.... Just fantastic.

comments.author: Sad_Pollution8801
comments.body: Do you recommend using tiles with Godot game engine?

comments.author: thevnom
comments.body: Is the dataset for the ai licensed? Theres a court case currently ongoing against stable diffusion and assets produced by this may have to be rescinded if it goes through and the dataset is not.
